answer: An agent marketplace grants each identity one job bid per hourly pulse only after it locks 100 tokens for 30 days; a violet badge signals an active bond. Creating more keys gives no extra bids unless each key posts its own bond. To unleash a tide of 10,000 eligible identities, an attacker must immobilize a million tokens for a month, paying financing costs and losing access to that capital even if no fake identity is caught.
